measured_bottleneck.v60_result: Phi-3 runtime evidence passed exactly but only 9/14 capabilities passed deterministic surface-form qualification.
measured_bottleneck.v61_result: A stronger Qwen2-7B source also failed exact surface gates on semantically useful output, while separately exposing one real nonce-corruption and one ceiling termination.
measured_bottleneck.hypothesis: An independent prompt-conditioned semantic judge can separate useful complete supervision from both genuine source errors and deterministic surface-rule false negatives without changing any frozen source output.

preflight.selection: For each capability, select one lowest-hash prior deterministic pass and one lowest-hash prior deterministic failure when both exist; otherwise take the two lowest hashes. Rank SHA-256(protocol_id + ':preflight:' + probe_id).

full.selection: Every frozen V60 search and validation record; no final-test records exist.

decision_rule: Run the 28-record adversarially stratified semantic-judge preflight exactly once.
Reject V62 if any judgment is unparsable, ceiling terminated, lacks authoritative IDs, uses non-CUDA execution or CPU offload, or if the judge emits only constant pass or constant fail decisions.
If preflight passes, judge all 3,136 frozen V60 search and validation responses exactly once.
Do not change the source outputs, catalog, rubric, thresholds, judge model, or runtime after observing preflight or full results.
A full semantic result may authorize a separately hashed derived composition only if all 14 capabilities pass search-depth, validation-rate, and Wilson gates.
The original V60 deterministic failure remains historical and must be reported alongside any V62 semantic qualification.
Do not invoke LayerCake until the derived ABI artifact separately passes composition integrity, segregation, and teacher-artifact adequacy audits.
claim_boundary: V62 can qualify frozen source responses for ABI acquisition material. It cannot prove ABI-to-LayerCake transfer, LayerCake quality, or LayerCake performance. An integrated candidate must later pass independent teacher-relative, isolation, receiver-identity, CPU speed, TTFO, RSS, sparse-execution, and three-seed gates.
